Turns out, this report is probably fake, or at the very least, was not backed up by enough evidence to be considered credible.

The above news outlets got wind of this SINGLE TWEET, and ran with it. No one had any more information on this, not even a short video was recorded.

It got so big that CNN themselves demanded a response from RCN (the cable broadcasters that serviced the Boston area):

The RCN cable operator in Boston aired inappropriate content for 30 minutes on CNN last night. CNN has asked for an explanation.

This is not proof that it happened. It's proof that they thought it had happened and were triyng to get ahead of it (and push the blame on someone else).

It's more than likely not legit. The twitter account of solikearose has since gone private due to:

weirdos sending me hate mail in the wake of #bourdainporn

If this really did happen, there would be more evidence of it, instead of just a single, easily docotred image.

TL;DR: This story came from a single tweet by solikearose, a twitter account apparently residing in Boston. Everyone ran with the story even though they had no corroborating evidence. The twitter account has since gone private. Be careful what you believe on the internet.
